work_experiences.job_description:
Incorporated cutting-edge architectures from research papers to enhance image quality and resolution.
Implemented advanced Super-Resolution techniques using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Generative
Adversarial Networks (GANs), and Transformers.
Conducted image segmentation using CNNs with state-of-the-art architectures tailored to ship and building detection.

details.description:
Conducted Lunar Surface Mineral Mapping utilizing the ISRO Chandrayaan-2 IIRS spectrometer and ISRO
Chandrayaan-1 M3 spectrometer.
Applied advanced Deep Learning techniques, specifically Graph Convolutional Networks, for the classification of
Hyperspectral Images.
Employed Efficient Graph Formulation and Normalization methods to optimize the spectral analysis process.
Utilized Spectral Unmixing and Subpixel Mapping to enhance mixed pixel discrimination.

technical_papers.title: Efficient Graph Formulation and Latent Space Integration for Lunar Hyperspectral Image Classification

details.description: Compares different graph formulation techniques for mapping minerals on the lunar surface from hyperspectral images obtained from the ISRO Chandrayaan-2 mission. The main focus of the work is on Graph Convolutional Networks. Additionally, we explore the effectiveness of latent space projection for feature extraction and generalization purposes. By leveraging efficient techniques we aim to improve the interpretability and performance of the GCN in the context of lunar surface mineral mapping.

details.description:
Build a voice assistant that can also locate misplaced belongings in a confined environment. We developed a
user-friendly desktop application with a dedicated hardware product using wall-mountable Wi-Fi-enabled HD
cameras. Such an assistant will be invaluable to people with limited vision and elders suffering from Deep
learning for memory loss (dementia).

Developed a website to help users make Hospital appointment booking hassle-free.
I have hands-on experience in developing this website using HTML and CSS for frontend, Python with Flask
for backend, and MySQL database for data management. I successfully deployed the website using Heroku.

Created an app that provides college students with access to timetables, facility availability, a way to submit
assignments, and online course registration, among other features.
Gained valuable experience in utilizing Android Studio for creating this app.

projects.title: Potato Leaf Disease Detection using CNN

details.description:
Deployed a Model that is trained on 3 types of disease datasets.
Used keras API, tf dataset from Tensorflow.
Used ImageDataGenerator API for Image Preprocessing and Data Augmentation.
Used CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks) for Image Classification.
Integrated the Model with backend server hosted using Fast API.
Presented the Webpage where users can drag and drop a Potato leaf Image to Predict the disease.
Predicts the disease with an Average confidence of 95%.

technical_papers.title: Revolution of AI-Enabled Health Care Chat-Bot System for Patient Assistance

details.description: Chat-Bot is like our personal virtual assistants which can conduct a conversation through textual methods or auditory methods. One of the important tools of AI is Chabot’s which can interact directly with humans and provide them with a considerate solution to their problem. These kinds of AI programs are designed to simulate how a human behaves as a conversational partner, after passing the Turing test. Chabot’s are generally accessed via public virtual assistants such as Google Assistant, Microsoft Cortana, Apple Siri, or via various individual organizations’ apps and websites. The process of building a Chat-Bot involves two tasks: understanding the user’s intent and predicting the correct solution. In the development of Chat-Bot, the first task is to understand the input entered by the user. The prophecy is made depending on the first task. The main feature one can use of Dialog Flow API is follow-up intent. By using follow-up intent, one can create a decision tree that will help in the prediction of a disease by the Chat-Bot. Through this project, one can get insights into the actual understanding of Chat-Bot, explore various NLP techniques, and understand how to harness the power of NLP tools (Bennet Praba et al in Int J Innov Technol Explor Eng 9:3470–3473, (2019) [1]). One can thoroughly enjoy building their Chat-Bot from scratch and learning the advancements in the domain of machine learning and general AI.

technical_papers.title: MALIGNANT SKIN CANCER DETECTION USING CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORKING

details.description:
The incidence of skin cancer is increasing by epidemic proportions. According to WHO, Skin Cancer is the world’s 6th most common cancer. It can be classified into Basal cell carcinoma, Squamous cell carcinoma and Melanoma among which Melanoma is more difficult to predict. By using this method, we can assist dermatologists to detect at an early stage as Computer Vision plays a vital role in diagnosis.

In this paper, to detect skin cancer we are using machine learning-based algorithms. Traditionally classification algorithms are Convolutional neural networking which Consists of initialization, adding a convolutional layer, summing pooling layer, summing flattening layer, summing a dense layer, then compiling Convolutional neural networks and fitting the CNN model to a dataset. We used machine learning model architecture to determine if the skin images of the patients are harmful or harmless via using machine learning libraries provided in python. We have chosen this approach to be more precise and specific in recognizing about cancer and ultimately declining the mortality rate caused by it.

details.description:

In this Deep Learning project, we will build a model for the classification of traffic signs available in the image into many categories using a convolutional neural network(CNN) and Keras library

We built a model that will be able to buy and sell stock based on profitable prediction, without any human interactions. Mismanaged inventory means disappointed customers, too much cash tied up in slower sales and warehouses. This inventory is eliminated paper work, human faults, manual delay and speed up process. This inventory management system will have the ability to track sales and available inventory, tells a shopkeeper when it is time to reorder and how much to purchase.

projects.title: Estimation of Heat Sources using inverse methods

details.description:
1. Created and tested methodology for estimation of strength of multiple heat sources by measuring temperature elsewhere in the system.
2. Tested multiple neural network architectures for Surrogate forward model creation using input simulation data from COMSOL.
3. Checked performance or MH-MCMC Algorithm and Genetic Algorithms for estimation techniques.
4. Gathered data on susceptibility of process to measurement noise, improper data & estimation accuracy

projects.title: Application of Neural Network based Forward Model for Parameter Estimation in Heat Transfer

details.description:
Worked on advancing research fields of Inverse methods in heat transfer.

1. Established clear basis and methods to utilise neural networks in thermal parameter estimation.
2. Used Inverse Methodology and a Physics based NN forward model and Metropolis-Hastings Markov Chain Monte Carlo Algorithm (MH-MCMC) to estimate Emissivity of a surface.
3. Analysed Robustness of the system to addition of Noise in Temperature measurement and input parameters.

work_experiences.job_description:
Using Restful web services & automated CI/CD data pipelines to reduce manual data processing in a project.
Implementing API's using Java, GitLab, Concourse, Swagger, PostgreSQL, PCF services, and creating a project management strategy road-map.
Sending and receiving data to vendors via HTTP RESTful API calls.
Developing a continuous deployment pipeline with Concourse.
Developing, validating, and deploying API's using Java-SpringBoot on different environments.
Communicating with clients.

Officer Apps Dev Programmer Analyst 2 at Citi, experienced in Full Stack Development using Java and ReactJS.
Collaborate closely with business analysts and project managers to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Design, develop, and maintain complex applications, with a focus on the content publisher application for Citi.
Proficiently handled data retrieval from 3rd party APIs, manipulate JSON data for streamlined delivery, worked on frontend tasks.

projects.title: Blockchain based secure equipment Diagnosis Mechanism of Smart Grid

details.description:
Objective: To implement BlockChain based forensics analysis, secure node diagnosis mechanism of smart grid which helps in identifying and preventing cyber-crimes, equipment diagnosis on the internet.
Malicious activity of DBA has not been monitored. Thus, a forensic process is applied for detecting and monitoring the activities that’s why to implement User reputation-based participatory incentive mechanisms in social and community intelligence systems using Blockchain Technology.

projects.title: Feel Safe App: An Interactive and Real-Time Location Tracking Mobile App for Kids, Ladies and Senior Citizens

details.description:
Objective: Geographical Location Based Tracking System is specially designed for School kids, senior citizens and women especially when they are traveling alone. It covers the major feature for maintaining details of kids’ location as well as senior citizens and women after every 30 minutes.
An Android based application uses the Android SDK, Eclipse IDE as front end and SQLite Database as back-end technology.

work_experiences.job_description:
• Composed more than 10 Data Analysis projects, demonstrating ability to select and organize relevant project content.
• Curated educational content from over 60 two-hour lectures, streamlining learning resources for enhanced accessibility and efficiency.
• Reviewed about 2000 student Data Analysis projects, bolstering project assessment skills while solidifying expertise in the field.
• Actively addressed 300 student doubts in DA, enhancing communication abilities and student feedback.

-> As part of the Virtual Internship Program I have completed the Salesforce Trailhead modules.

-> This Internship has allowed me to understand the fundamentals and operations of being a Salesforce Developer however I believe its just a drop in the ocean.

Certificate Link: https://smartinternz.com/internships/salesforce_certificates/74e3122d8341c62364974ff94af60090

• Spearheaded around 8 Machine Learning projects, including Sentiment Analysis, Speech Emotion Recognition, Text Emotion Recognition, and more, with a focus on the entire project life-cycle from data collection to pre-production deployment.
• Mentored and guided 200 students remotely, fostering strong communication and teaching skills; facilitated their proficiency in Machine Learning tools and techniques, resulting in a 40% increase in project completion rate and exceptional student feedback.

• Completed 8 varied Data Analysis projects, including Hiring Process Optimization, IMDB Movie Analysis, and Bank Loan Case Study, demonstrating a wide range of skills and expertise.

• Directed a complex portfolio encompassing eight Data Analytics projects, orchestrating problem identification, data collection, and in-depth analysis, amplifying project leadership acumen and advancing my data analysis proficiency by a significant 55% .

• Developed AI Mental Fitness Tracker using 5+ Python ML algorithms for IBM SkillsBuild Program with Edunet Foundation and A.I.C.T.E.
• Delivered technical presentation detailing model approach and implementation.

details.description:
A web application developed that helps people keep track of daily life individual and shared expenses (group expenses). 
This application contains an optimized “Simplify debt algorithm” for the least possible transaction occurrence to settle debts.
For faster data interpretation, the Backend API is developed on .NET Core Framework.

projects.title: Used Car price prediction using Machine Learning technique

details.description:
A web application which predicts the price of a used car for the best resale price.
My team used a Multinomial Regression and Random Forest Regression algorithm to predict the car price value with high accuracy (achieved around 97.56% accuracy).
Flask is used for deploying a machine learning algorithm and web application.

-	A Desktop Application consisting of two side interfaces.
-	The restaurant employee uses one side of the application to place an order for a customer. Which also contains a POS (Point of Sales) system for a faster and tracked payment system.
-	Another side is used for managing staff members’ details, ordering and customer details.
-	At the end of every term, the application generates a report on every Sales and Management department database.

work_experiences.job_description: My role is to design ”Real time stepper motor learning system”. The agenda of this project is “The work should be done by the robot without human changing their place”. The robot is equipped with Bluetooth module. For the working of robot, we had designed a mobile Application. In which the control of the robot can be done without human moving from his position. And the robot back tracks it's initial position atomatically.

details.description: In normal drone practices there is an easy chance of tracking the exact location of the operator of the drone. In order to work with a drone for longer time & distances there is a chance of lack of sufficient power. Loss of communication between the drone and operator. In order to reduce these problems by using AI Techniques the counter attacks can be minimized. To overcome the location tracking problem Drone in Drone System is proposed.This technique is also used to cover longer distances.

spine fracture detection.
present

generalization.

•Evaluated model performance using a comprehensive set of metrics on a separate
test dataset.

•The app includes login/sign-up, a music player with shuffle,repeat queue, and
repeat current song options.
05/2023

private playlists.
•User-friendly website for exploring the musical world
•Tech-stack: HTML, CSS, javascript , bootstrap , Nodejs , MongoDB

•REST API specifically designed for e-commerce applications.
12/2022

utilizes JWT authentication for user login and authorization.
•Use mongoDB local or Add your own Mongo Atlas Admin Username, (required to
be updated in nodemon.json)

•Facilitates collaboration among individuals or groups, fostering regular content
creation and sharing.
06/2022
•Empowers users with CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) capabilities for their
blogs, enhancing the user experience and content management.
• Supports REST API functionality for seamless data interaction, making it easy to
create, access, and manage content.
•Tech-stack: javascript, Nodejs, Expressjs, MongoDB, Mongoose, postman, Mongo
Atlas
